name: RecallCampaignCompletionTracker
tagline: Drive every recalled VIN to a completed remedy – outreach, bookings, parts and stop-sale stock in one app.
description: A complete recall and field-action campaign app for dealers: completion rate per campaign against the OEM target, a VIN-level outreach board with logged contact attempts, bookings with parts-availability rules, a stop-sale list for stock vehicles and a full vehicle register – in one Power Apps code component for Canvas, Model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: Completion rate vs target per campaign
Remedy funnel and remedies per week
Drag-and-drop outreach board with transition rules
Log contact: method, outcome, attempts, history
Stop-sale stock with Book → Start → Complete & release
Flags: no-show, critical overdue, follow-up due, max attempts, not contacted, parts, missing contact details, invalid VIN
Bulk contact, status, assignment, export and delete with Undo
Phone layout with bottom view bar
controlType: standard (2 controls: data-set + Power Pages field)
